description: TAC, the paper's main instance (SAC-Discrete-like): LLM Q critic per state and move; the strict actor loss judges each move by the critic's view of every legal move; the critic loss checks against the critic's assessment of the next move played (TD, SARSA); every step on its own, critic from before the update. Differs from SAC-Discrete: no entropy term, a SARSA target, one critic.
